tasks.short: Maintain complete and accurate student records

steps.what: Gather and verify student information required for the record
Maintain student records by entering required facts and updating existing fields
Check accuracy, completeness and required access restrictions before saving student records

tasks.design: Configure a single record view and explicit completeness checks in the {OTHER} student-record system. Reuse verified existing fields and remove duplicate document transcription; the counsellor captures new facts and checks meaning and access before saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Student facts may be repeated across forms and documents.
tasks.enabler_now: Native record forms can reuse explicit fields and flag missing entries without generating a student assessment.
tasks.still_hard: Conflicting sources, sensitive notes and knowing which requirements apply locally.
tasks.human_edge: The counsellor distinguishes an accurate fact from an unsupported interpretation.
tasks.altitude: Less duplicate entry, with unchanged responsibility for the record.

reach.task: Check whether a permitted record attachment is present
reach.learn: Record identifiers and restricted access boundaries

evidence.claim: Native structured record reuse and completeness checks can reduce duplicate entry; this is an E1 design and not evidence of automatic accuracy or local compliance.

assumptions: Boundary is counsellor record maintenance, not counselling or original school administration. The US district wording means applicable local institutional requirements, not an assumed European rule set.
Counsellor s1 produces checked student ID, event date, source, factual update, attachment references and uncertainty. All collection and verification retain 35 hours.

s2 captures new fields and any narrative, with checking and manual exceptions within 22.5 retained hours. Existing school administrators produce identity and enrolment fields through unchanged normal work; those are reused only after counsellor identity checking.
Record owner supplies approved mandatory-field, access and retention requirements through existing governance. Counsellor upkeep covers configuration checks; no new owner work is assumed.
Test native forms before custom code. Missing or conflicting information returns to manual source checking; completeness checks cannot certify factual truth.
unknowns: Native access controls and field reuse
research_questions: Does one record view reduce entry time after full capture, meaning checks and access checks?

already_counted.description: Capture new information and resolve entry exceptions
Final accuracy, completeness and access check

incremental.description: Maintain field mappings and completeness checks

approvals.approved_version: Exact student ID, record version, source references, factual updates, attachments and access setting checked before save; changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100; R=35+22.5+20=77.5. Gross 22.5 less 2 upkeep gives net 20.5. High requires duplicate entry within the 45-hour update slice; low assumes native reuse already works or manual source correction dominates. Verification and final checking retain all time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Counsel students about education and careers

steps.what: Clarify students' educational issues, goals and practical constraints
Look up current course, program, scheduling and registration information
Counsel students on course selection, adjustment, study habits and career planning

tasks.design: Configure a current course-information index in the {DOCS} or {OTHER} student system for factual lookup. The counsellor hears the student's goals, checks source requirements and discusses choices; no automated admission, aptitude score or career decision is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: Course rules and dates can require searching multiple documents.
tasks.enabler_now: Native indexing can shorten factual lookup while keeping interpretation and guidance personal.
tasks.still_hard: Balancing interests, access barriers and uncertainty about future choices.
tasks.human_edge: The counsellor helps the student articulate priorities and make their own informed choice.
tasks.altitude: Less factual searching; counselling and decision rights remain unchanged.

reach.task: Locate an approved registration contact for a student
reach.learn: Current course contacts and information boundaries

evidence.claim: An indexed approved course catalogue can assist factual guidance preparation, but the time estimate is unmeasured model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary includes counselling and a bounded factual lookup, not enrolment processing or record maintenance.

Counsellor s1 produces goals and constraints through conversation. In s2 the counsellor selects course category, level, dates and access constraints and checks source currency within 12 retained hours.
Course owner produces course ID, scope, prerequisites, dates, registration route and version through unchanged publication work. Additional index upkeep is included in focal incremental time.
Test native search and filters first. Missing or conflicting requirements lead to source-owner confirmation or manual checking, not inferred eligibility.
Counselling descriptions may overlap personal-problem counselling; assign actual contact hours once in the roll-up.
unknowns: Share of sessions involving factual course lookup
research_questions: Does indexed lookup reduce total preparation time without shortening the student's discussion?

already_counted.description: Select filters, verify course facts and handle source gaps

incremental.description: Maintain current catalogue links and topic index

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100; R=35+12+45=92. Gross 8 less 1 upkeep gives net 7. Low assumes little course lookup or already clear sources; high needs a 20-hour search slice. Goal exploration and counselling retain 80 hours.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Provide crisis intervention to students when difficult situations occur at schools

tasks.design: Keep crisis intervention with the counsellor and the school's authorised response team. Existing procedures in the {DOCS} support their work without an automated triage score or a new recording requirement.
tasks.previous_blocker: The response depends on the immediate situation and the student's needs.
tasks.enabler_now: No technical change is proposed to replace this direct intervention.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising urgent concerns and coordinating appropriate support promptly.
tasks.human_edge: The counsellor listens, observes and acts within their competence.
tasks.altitude: Intervention responsibilities and time remain unchanged.

reach.task: Clarify who follows up after an immediate school concern

evidence.claim: Crisis intervention remains direct human work; no contact-time saving is inferred from documentation technology.

assumptions: Boundary is direct intervention and immediate coordination, not later incident notes or specialist treatment.
Counsellor receives the student's account and observes circumstances directly. No structured crisis severity input or machine response is assumed.
Existing native procedure access remains sufficient; no new capture, software or upkeep is introduced, so incremental work is zero.
unknowns: School response responsibilities and local escalation arrangements
research_questions: Are immediate handover responsibilities understood by the human response team?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100 and incremental=0. Direct support and immediate coordination retain all focal time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Counsel people about problems affecting education or work

steps.what: Counsel individuals or groups about personal, social or behavioral problems affecting education or work

tasks.design: Retain personal and group counselling with the counsellor. Existing approved support information in the {DOCS} may be consulted as today without analysing the conversation through a new tool.
tasks.previous_blocker: Understanding a personal difficulty requires trust and contextual conversation.
tasks.enabler_now: No technical change is proposed within this contact boundary.
tasks.still_hard: Helping a person understand barriers without imposing an unsupported explanation.
tasks.human_edge: The counsellor listens, checks understanding and supports the person's own choices.
tasks.altitude: Counselling contact and responsibility stay unchanged.

reach.task: Discuss whether an agreed support need falls within another service's scope
reach.learn: Referral limits and respectful information sharing

evidence.claim: Personal and group counselling remain human work; this design claims no saving by substituting automated support.

assumptions: Boundary is counselling, not separate record writing, appointment scheduling or specialist diagnosis.
Clients produce concerns and priorities directly. No structured behavioural score or automatic need classification is assumed.
Native reference access remains as today; no new recording or ongoing upkeep is introduced, so incremental work is zero.
Any contact also counted under educational counselling or crisis support must have one owner in the roll-up.
unknowns: Client circumstances and professional support boundaries
research_questions: What barriers do clients identify to carrying out their own agreed next steps?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 and R=100 with incremental=0. Individual and group counselling retain all contact time.

role.altitude: Reduce duplicate record entry and factual course searching while retaining counselling and crisis support.
reach: Clarify support handovers with a school social worker
Check permitted record completeness with a social service assistant
skills_to_grow: Keep counselling decisions separate from data completeness checks
role.ambitious_version: Maintain a checked student record and current information references while preserving time for students.
